snippet.title: Siren's Call: Second Wind - Trailer #1 - Love Is In The Air
snippet.description:
A wedding where one of the guests arrives dead. A strange black hole eclipsing the Florida sun. And your best friend? Gone. Is all this a butterfly dream or is reality breaking? Is their story romance or mystery? Your choices will determine the genre of his soul. Welcome to the town of Siren's Call.

Sign up for our kickstarter here for more updates: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1943441370/sirens-call-second-wind-love-is-in-the-air

Dream A Little Dream of Me (Cover) - by Huong Su
